name: The Pro Crastinators Dating Sim
source:
Parasocial Paradise!

You're a transfer student to the illustrious PCP University, a place where dreams go to die. You hope to get good grades and leave this place behind to become a successful businessman or something. But it's going to be tough trying to get an octuple major when you're being distracted by bodacious boys on all sides!
